tldr: Evening batch, Aug 12: a lean window since midday, dominated by agent economics and governance. Anthropic extends its Compliance API to local Claude Code/Cowork session transcripts and reveals Claude Code's effort dial now scales up to ten parallel agents; AMD, Arm, and Microsoft argue agentic workloads could shift CPU-to-GPU ratios from 1:4 toward 1:1. DeepSeek V4 Flash outguns Microsoft's new MAI Code 1.1 Flash on both price and performance, Intel's LLM-Scaler adds Muse Glimmer support, and Upstage's Solar Pro 4 is free for a week in Nous Portal.

articles.title: Solar Pro 4: Upstage's Agentic Model Free for a Week in Nous Portal
articles.summary: Upstage's Solar Pro 4, built for multi-step tasks over long documents with ask-when-unsure behavior, is free for a week exclusively in Nous Portal.

articles.title: Claude Code Effort Dial Scales from Zero to Ten Parallel Agents
articles.summary: Claude Code's effort setting now ranges from no agents to up to 10 parallel Claude Code agents — cost traded for autonomy at higher levels.

articles.title: Anthropic Compliance API Now Covers Local Claude Code Sessions
articles.summary: Beta for Claude Enterprise: GET /v1/compliance/apps/sessions/local returns transcripts of Cowork and Claude Code sessions on users' machines.

articles.title: AMD, Arm, Microsoft: Agentic AI Could Push CPU-to-GPU Ratios to 1:1
articles.summary: At OCP APAC 2026, AMD/Arm/Microsoft argue agentic AI adds CPU-side orchestration and retrieval — shifting the 1:4 CPU-to-GPU ratio toward 1:2 or 1:1.

articles.title: Intel LLM-Scaler Adds Muse Glimmer Support
articles.summary: Intel's LLM-Scaler tooling is ready with Muse Glimmer support, alongside new LLM and feature coverage for local inference workflows.

articles.title: Microsoft's MAI Code 1.1 Flash Gets Crushed by DeepSeek on Price and Performance
articles.summary: MAI Code 1.1 Flash is 25% more token-efficient at a quarter of its predecessor's cost — but the cheaper DeepSeek V4 Flash still wins on both axes.
